kind: Controlled identical-time directional-wave/wind replay; same camera, sky, hydro snapshot and source phases
limits: Bounded QA render, not production frame-rate measurement
SWE snapshot and sky/cloud field remain fixed; caustics and foliage shadow update at replay times
Residual includes real wave/wind motion; not all reduction is removal of sampling noise

disabled.kind: actual rendered ROI temporal audit; appearance residuals are not a direct noise/flicker verdict
limits: Readback and CPU registration perturb frame intervals: do not use this as a performance benchmark.
Canvas samples are tone-mapped display-sRGB decoded to linear display values, not scene radiance.
Block translation with forward/back rejection is a limited optical-flow approximation; deformation, occlusion, specular appearance and true water motion can remain in residuals.
Use static phase-locked tests and identical-time supersampled/shutter references before attributing residuals to aliasing.
Mean/percentile/energy tracks are descriptive; no automatic pass or claim that all temporal change is noise.
Default independent-rAF scheduling is only an assumption for preserveDrawingBuffer=false. Prefer a hook inside the same main frame immediately after its final draw.
Input hashes are diagnostic FNV, not cryptographic evidence; exact RGB change counts and examples audit the underlying captured buffers.
